weights.description: Optional. The weight of each hybrid query clause, positional against hybrid.queries. When set, must hold exactly 5 entries — the maximum hybrid.queries length — each in the [0.0, 1.0] range, with a sum equal to 1.0. Weights are decimal percentages: the closer a weight is to 1.0, the more weight is given to its clause. When a query has fewer than 5 clauses, the weights of the clauses it provides are rescaled to sum to 1.0. If not provided, every clause is given equal weight.
